title: 178. Implement Queue using Stacks

examples.explanation: Push 1 then push 2. Peek returns 1, pop removes and returns 1, then empty returns false (encoded as 0) because 2 remains.
Push 1. Peek returns 1, pop returns 1, then the queue is empty so empty returns true (encoded as 1).
Push 1, 2, 3. Pop returns 1, peek returns 2, pop returns 2, and empty returns false (0) because 3 remains.

hints: Use two stacks: push onto the input stack, and lazily move elements to the output stack when a peek or pop needs the front.
Empty checks whether both stacks have no elements. Encode empty as 1 for true and 0 for false.
